effects.name: evidence-policy-file-read
effects.source: the project-relative evidence-policy JSON file named by freeze or rebind-pack --pack-evidence-file
effects.capture: its bytes, bound in the pack inventory like the other pack files, and the decoded command argv and reports requirement

effects.name: evidence-policy-pack-write
effects.detail: a freeze or rebind with --pack-evidence-file writes a pack inventory that binds the policy file, carries its decoded policy, and includes it in the test-set digest; a Vouch release older than this one cannot read that inventory (a declared store action, D-31 note); a freeze without the file writes the inventory byte-for-byte as before
